method: 逐年检查zh/w，优先明显语义、否定范围、词条与释义词性一致性；英文锚点定位。每次写前重读并检查最新原字节，保护并发插入的说明；未重推答案，不改en、role、题号或时刻。

changes.en_anchor: Moreover, like the storyteller of old, although you will invariably be telling your story to someone who knows quite a bit about it already, you are expected to present it as if it had never been heard before.
changes.before: 而且，像旧时的说书人一样，尽管听众往往已经很了解你的故事，你仍然要把它当作一个从未被听过的故事来讲。
changes.after: 而且，像旧时的说书人一样，尽管你总是在向已经相当了解这个故事的人讲述，仍然应当把它当作一个从未被听过的故事来讲。
changes.reason: invariably是总是、无例外，不能弱化为往往。

changes.en_anchor: In short, you should write for someone who knows little about your area of study, taking little for granted about your reader’s knowledge of your area of study.

after.m: phr.把……视为理所当然（本句little表示少作这种假定）

changes.reason: 保留词条本义，把little造成的否定/限制写成语境说明。

changes.en_anchor: Toastmasters is open to the public at large.

after.m: phr.全体；整个（the public at large指广大公众）

changes.reason: 固定搭配指公众整体，避免用普遍地这一不确切副词义。

after.m: interj.欢迎（此处为独立欢迎语）

changes.reason: 独立招呼语的welcome是感叹用语，此处不是及物动词。

changes.en_anchor: They might touch more and if they’re jostled in a crowd, they won’t feel violated.
changes.reason: 动词原形词条给出主动本义，被动含义另标本句用法。

changes.en_anchor: In any multicultural situation, these assumptions need to be taken into account for successful interactions.

after.m: phr.把……考虑在内（本句为被动）

changes.reason: 词条take into account是主动搭配；不把其本义写成被考虑。

changes.en_anchor: And adults could indeed acquire the second language, at least in part.
changes.before: 不过，成年人确实也能够习得第二语言，至少能习得其中的一部分。
changes.after: 不过，成年人确实也能够习得第二语言，至少在一定程度上是这样。
changes.reason: at least in part修饰习得的程度，不能窄化为只习得语言中的某一部分。

changes.en_anchor: For instance, when we observe casually, we may not be aware of factors that bias our observations, and, and when we rarely keep formal records of our observations.
changes.before: 例如，随意观察时，我们可能意识不到哪些因素使自己的观察带有偏见，而且我们很少正式记录观察结果。
changes.after: 例如，随意观察时，我们可能意识不到哪些因素使观察结果产生偏差，而且我们很少正式记录观察结果。
changes.reason: 研究方法中的bias指系统性偏差，不只指主观偏见。

changes.en_anchor: For instance, when we observe casually, we may not be aware of factors that bias our observations, and, and when we rarely keep formal records of our observations.
changes.reason: 行为观察语境下bias是使结果带有偏差，范围宽于主观偏见。

changes.en_anchor: For example, a cook changes a recipe or even makes one up using ingredients he or she has on hand to produce a new one.
changes.before: 例如，厨师修改一道菜的食谱，甚至用手头已有的食材自创一道新菜。
changes.after: 例如，厨师会修改现有的食谱，甚至利用手头的食材自创一份新食谱。
changes.reason: one承接recipe，指新食谱，不直接改换成一道菜。

changes.en_anchor: Let’s move onto the third one.
changes.reason: 转向下一个话题的搭配词条写作move on to；保持英文表层move onto不改动。

changes.en_anchor: OK. We all work or very few people can get away with not working.

before.m: phr.做……而不受影响；得以蒙混过关

after.m: phr.做某事而不付出代价（此处指不工作仍能维持生活）

changes.reason: 本句不包含蒙混/欺骗含义，按实际不利后果与生活语境释义。

changes.en_anchor: Most psychologists are finding that a good exercise program, good nutrition, decreases the amount of stress, or the effect of stress on the body or in the mind.
changes.before: 大多数心理学家发现，良好的锻炼安排和充足的营养，能够减轻压力，或者减弱压力对身体和心理的影响。
changes.after: 大多数心理学家发现，良好的锻炼安排和合理的营养，能够减轻压力，或者减弱压力对身体和心理的影响。
changes.reason: good nutrition不限于营养数量充足；不把good误限为摄入量。

checked_examples: 2010 paralinguistic/physical/vocal形容词；breathiness/huskiness/nasality名词，未混写为相近词性。
2011 not all differences cause difficulty保留并非所有的部分否定；unconsciously为副词。
2012 not always used in isolation保留并不总是；observational/systematic/objective为形容词，systematically/randomly为副词。
2013 do not question everything译为并非怀疑一切；nothing without will没有被反译。
2014 stressful为令人有压力的，physiological为生理的，physiologically未混用；if not properly addressed的否定条件保留。
verification: 全部当前句子en/zh/w非空、span上下界与不重叠检查通过；保护字段改前改后一致。
